title: Person: uncle Charles
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

uncle Charles

anchor.prefix:
. Go on yourself.

 —Mary? Here, Stephen, here’s something to make your hair curl.

 He poured sauce freely over Stephen’s plate and set the boat again on the table. Then he asked
anchor.suffix:
was it tender. Uncle Charles could not speak because his mouth was full but he nodded that it was.

 —That was a good answer our friend made to the canon. What? said Mr Dedalus.
